notes.title: Happy Birthday!
notes.notes:
I've turned 30 on 14th June and to celebrate I've set the game to the maximum discount of 83% for a few days. My gift to you, since you are the sweetest and kindest people I've ever encountered here on Steam. 

I really want to say thank you to all of you again. In the beginning I was afraid there would be a lot of negativity here because of the subject's matter but you brought me more joy and love with your positive comments than I could have ever imagined. 

Keep on spreading positive vibes.

Thank you. <3

Peace & Love,
Patrick

notes.title: Please Help Each Other
notes.notes:
You all are so wonderful to each other in the comments and review sections. I can not always be there for you and I think it's about time to provide you with a safe space where you can help each other in desperate times but also spread positivity among yourselves.  

That's why I just opened a discord server for all of you:

https://discord.gg/DHhN96d

This is also the first place you will learn about my new game. A game where all of you will play the main part!

Peace & Love
Patrick

notes.title: Update 1.62
notes.notes:
I can't believe that it's already been a year since I released Tomorrow Don't Come! :O

Lots has been improved and further polished thanks to your feedback, which makes today's update number 18 and brings us to an average of 1.5 updates per month. 

[list][*]Chapter "Curtain" is now accessible again after a regular reset and does not require to reset all achievements anymore.
[*]Dual screen setups: the mouse will now only be contained to one screen when necessary during certain chapters.
[*]Moving Forward: improved the triggering of the next chapter.
[*]Fixed an audio bug where the whispers wouldn't stop after a reset.[/list]

If you find any more bugs, let me know. I'm always eager to fix them. I already know what my next game(s) will be but as you can imagine with all the updates I did for this game, there wasn't time to actually start working on them. I do hope though to have something ready by the end of the year. Stay tuned and follow me [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/peacelovegames]here[/url] to not miss any announcements. <3

Peace & Love
Patrick

notes.title: Update 1.61 Portuguese - Brazil added!
notes.notes:
Happy New Year everyone! <3

Thanks to to help of [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/gregstrider]Greg[/url] we now have subtitles available in Portuguese - Brazil! 

Also added with this update:
[list][*]Added a safety net for when you ALT + F4 out of "Trapped" which prevents messing up your mouse cursor speed settings.
[*]Fixed a bug in "Curtain" which made the frame rate unstable. It was just one little checkbox to deactivate. I really don't know when this happened. ^^
[*]Fixed a bug in "Curtain" which would make one subtitle only show up for half a second.

I wish you all the best in this new calendar cycle. Stay strong, be safe.

Peace & Love
Patrick

notes.title: Update 1.60
notes.notes:
Hey all you lovely people! :)

It's this time of the year again. How are you holding up? If you need someone to talk to during the holiday season, please feel free to send me a friend request. I'll be around for you. <3

I couldn't simply let this year end without another update. So here are the latest improvements & bug fixes coming with v1.60:
[list][*][b]Curtain:[/b] [list][*]added small improvements to chapter when achievement "Dead End" gets unlocked on first playthrough
[*]Improved transition back to chapter[/list]
[*][b]Trapped[/b]: [list][*]adjusted motion blur when playing with controller[/list]
[*][b]Menu[/b]: [list][*]fixed a bug where all progress would get reset after resetting chapters
[*]fixed a bug which would show the wrong hint when having subtitles enabled[/list]
[*][b]Safe[/b]: [list][*]fixed a bug where empty space at bottom would lead to wrong chapter
[*]fixed a bug where chapter "Let me die" would play shock wave effect at the beginning after clicking on empty space at the bottom of "Safe"
[*] Improved transition to chapters when clicking on empty spaces at the bottom.
[*]fixed a bug which prevented the possibility to open the Safe before completing all chapters[/list]
[*][b]Voices[/b]: [list][*]added new solution, the way it had been originally intended but I did not technically know how to implement back then[/list]
[*][b]Looking back[/b]:[list][*] fixed a bug where sound file would keep playing when coming back to Chapter
[*]added additional way to get to the solution of the chapter since it's the one most people struggle with[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.51 - 4K Support
notes.notes:
Here's another small update. Thanks to one of you sharing a picture of the game, I noticed there was a linking error with the new font in the chapter Safe. I was quickly able to fix it, but we then noticed that some of the texts are not scaled correctly when playing the game in a resolution higher than 1080p. It took a few hours, but now the game officially supports resolutions up to 4K! :)

I do not own a 4K screen, that's why I never saw this error, so please keep on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/758570/discussions/0/3377008022037187916/]reporting bugs[/url] if you see something not looking right. I'm just one person here with a limited setup, trying my best to not let any bugs slip through.

Peace & Love
Patrick

notes.title: Update 1.4
notes.notes:
Hello and welcome to the biggest update yet! The recent weeks I've been busy adding controller support to TOMORROW DON'T COME, which was quite the difficult task as you can imagine for those who've already played the game.

Since a controller has less buttons to interact with than mouse & keyboard, it makes solving the puzzles a little bit easier but on the other hand it delivers a more immersive gameplay feel. It's definitely worth playing through the game with both options since both deliver a little bit of a different experience.  

Small disclaimer though: I could only test it with a XBox 360 controller but it [b]should[/b] work with others as well. Here's also the rest of things that got improved during the extensive playtesting:

[list][*]Move forward
[list][*]Fixed a bug where steps sfx wouldn't play
[*]Fixed a bug where "I keep looking back" would stop moving if certain keys are pressed
[*]Fixed a bug where the brightness of the words wouldn't go back to normal after you've already moved backwards[/list][/list]
[list][*]Looking back
[list][*]Optimized the code to increase performance
[*]Fixed a bug that would only occur with a multiple monitors setup
[*]Fixed a sound bug when coming from the chapter selection
[*] Fixed a tiny error where an object had the Hex Code #000008 instead of #000000, causing it to appear slightly blue[/list][/list]
[list][*]Trapped
[list][*]Edited some sfx for a smoother experience when "trapped" appears after the build up
[*]Added a fade-in if coming from the chapter selection[/list][/list]
[list][*]Let me die
[list][*]Removed impact sfx because it didn't really fit and I like the symbolism of there being a bottomless pit better than hitting rock bottom
[*]Added a fade-in if coming from the chapter selection[/list][/list]
[list][*]Curtain
[list][*]Fixed a bug where a text was disappearing too fast
[*]Fixed a bug where a text would just appear without the typing
[*]Fixed a bug where the drone sound would play again when solving the chapter under certain circumstances[/list][/list]
[list][*]Chapter selection
[list][*]Updated the video for "Looking back" to give a better hint 
[*]Updated the video behaviour: if a chapter is solved, it will now automatically start playing the next unsolved one[/list][/list]
[list][*]Misc
[list][*]Added version number to start screen
[*]Fixed a bug where sfx on mouse-over wouldn't play the very first time you start up the game
[*]...and lots of other tiny stuff again to improve the overall polish that is not even worth mentioning[/list][/list]

Please report any bugs you encounter [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/758570/discussions/0/3377008022037187916/]here[/url]. I've spent two weeks only playtesting this time, so hopefully I didn't oversee anything grave. 

Peace & Love
Patrick

I'm currently focusing on adding more polish to the game and smoothen out all the edges. Below you can find most of the changes that got implemented with this update. [*]Fixed a bug where the words would fade before reaching the top[/list]

[*]Trapped
[list]

[*]Let me die
[list][*]Updated graphics when solving the puzzle

[*]Fixed a bug where graphics would not change after unlocking Breakout right before[/list]

[*]Updated the background fade when coming from the menu[/list]

[*]Wordplay
[list][*]You can now solve this in any order

[*]...and lots of other tiny changes & improvements that are hardly noticeable ^^
